name: io.github.vgnshiyer/apple-books-mcp
title: Apple Books
description: Access your Apple Books library, annotations, reading progress, and highlights through Claude

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BOOKS_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow the collection write tools (create, rename and delete collections; add and remove books). Writes refuse to run while Books is open and take a backup first.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BOOKS_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder holding the Apple Books stores (BKLibrary and AEAnnotation), if not ~/Library/Containers/com.apple.iBooksX/Data/Documents.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BOOKS_QUERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a library query may run before it is stopped (default 30; 0 for no limit).
